description: This source file 'pack-bitmap.c' appears to be part of a version control system (similar to Git) dealing with bitmap indexes of objects (commits, trees, blobs, tags). It includes structures and functions for reading, manipulating, and querying bitmap indexes, including handling mmap'ed files, loading from packfiles or multi-pack indexes, and performing bitmap-based reachability operations.

classes.name: stored_bitmap
classes.description: Represents an entry on the bitmap index, including object ID, bitmap data, and flags.

classes.name: bitmap_index
classes.description: Represents the active bitmap index for a repository, which could be based on a packfile or multi-pack index, and contains associated bitmap data and metadata.

classes.name: eindex
classes.description: Extended index for objects outside of packfiles, holding dynamic object arrays and hashes.

classes.name: bitmap_show_data
classes.description: Data structure used during bitmap show operations to pass bitmap index and base bitmaps.

classes.name: bitmap_boundary_cb
classes.description: Callback structure for managing boundary commit collections during boundary computations.

classes.name: include_data
classes.description: Structure used to manage include and exclusion data during reachability traversals.

classes.name: bitmap_lookup_table_triplet
classes.description: Structure representing a triplet in the bitmap lookup table, containing commit position, offset, and xor row.

classes.name: bitmap_lookup_table_xor_item
classes.description: Represents a commit id and offset in the chain for XOR operations in bitmap lookup tables.
